finding.text: The brief says "no console errors", but layout.json `errors` lists a 404 "Failed to load resource" at both 400 and 1920. The diff does not say which URL it is; name it (or show it is unrelated, e.g. a favicon) before landing.
one-dashboard.md still says "`TasksPage.js` is gone" in the same sentence that now says `/tasks/` draws `core/Task/TasksPage.js`. The two clauses contradict each other; drop the old clause.

The brief asks for the decision and its alternative (Inbox forward vs TasksPage) to be recorded in the task log. The diff holds no log line, so I can't confirm it. Written in the task log, not seen here.
At 400 the page is 24195px tall (254 items, band share 24.2), a very long scroll; at 1920 it is 7824px in three columns. It works but is heavy on mobile (shots/127-0-0-1-62182-tasks/400.png).
A long row title, "document-all-the-moving-parts-of-the-sys", is cut mid-word at both widths (a slug used as a title). That is a data issue, not this diff.
